rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides scanner integration through the SANE (Scanner Access Now Easy) framework, enabling document capture with support for ADF (Automatic Document Feeder), duplex scanning, and configurable page sizes. Built with TypeScript and featuring both stdio and HTTP transports, it offers tools for device discovery, scan job management with real-time status tracking, and automatic document assembly from individual pages into multi-page TIFF files. The implementation includes intelligent device selection that prefers ADF-capable scanners over cameras, configurable document break policies for batch processing, and comprehensive job tracking with manifest files and event logs, making it valuable for digitizing physical documents, automating batch scanning workflows, and building document management systems that require programmatic scanner control.
